hindi_topic: मृदा नमी स्तर एवं सिंचाई समय
guidelines: For most field crops, optimal soil moisture is 50-70% of Field Capacity. If capacitive/resistive sensor reads below 30-35% moisture in the root zone, light irrigation should be initiated. For loamy soil, moisture levels between 40-60% ensure active root respiration without anaerobic waterlogging.
precautions: Avoid heavy flood irrigation before forecasted rainfall to prevent root rot and lodging.

hindi_topic: फसलों में सिंचाई की प्रमुख अवस्थाएं
stages: Wheat: Crown root initiation (20-25 days), flowering (80-85 days). Mustard: Rosette stage (30 days) and siliquae formation (60 days). Gram/Pulses: Pre-flowering and pod development (DO NOT irrigate during peak flowering as flowers drop). Rice: Tillering to grain filling. Potato: Tuber initiation and tuber bulking.

benefits: Drip irrigation delivers 90%+ water use efficiency with 30-40% fertilizer savings through fertigation. Sprinkler irrigation is ideal for closely spaced crops like mustard, wheat, and pulses on undulating terrain. PMKSY scheme offers up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers.
